lines.line: Hmm?
Is there anything I can help you with?
Nah. I don't think so.
Don't bother me, peasant. I've had a long journey and paid too much coin on these gifts to be late to Vittoria's wedding.
Enjoy the wedding.
Indeed. If we ever get there.
Loyal Nords are always welcome here. Anyone else better watch their step.
If I were you, I'd keep away from the barrow on the east side of town... it's haunted.
I'd like to rent a room. (10 gold)
Sure thing. It's yours for a day.
If there are five hundred steps to each marker then maybe...Argh! This is pointless. Dar'Rakki can not rely on shortcuts!
Any thoughts on the townsfolk?
This is a good place to hide one's identity, no? Ivarstead attracts those who cling to lofty ideals. They never suspect our faces are two.
You see those warriors from Hammerfell? They've got curved swords. Curved. Swords.
What do you play?
I play the lute. If you'd like to hear something, it only costs five gold.
This has to be the worst place in Skyrim to run a mill. How am I supposed to do anything with all those bears running around?
What's making you so angry?
My business is falling apart, my apprentice never listens to me and now there's talk of dragons.
If I hadn't sunk every bit of gold I had into my mill, I would have picked up and left Ivarstead long ago.
You want a drink?
What's on the menu?
Depends. Are you thirsty, hungry, both?
Anything you can tell me about High Hrothgar?
I've always fancied a journey up the 7,000 Steps to the monastery.
Anything to break the boredom of living in this town. I envy you.
Need something?
All right, hand over your valuables, or I'll gut you like a fish.
Walk away. Right now. (Intimidate)
Nice try, but you don't scare me.
I'm not going to ask again.
I'd rather die!
Then I guess that's your last request, fool!
